description: This file contains implementation of the StringCordView class and related functions for handling string-like data structures, as well as functions related to SourceRange and stack trace formatting within the torch::jit namespace.

classes.name: StringCordView
classes.description: A string-like class backed by a vector of string_view, representing concatenated string segments without requiring continuous memory.

classes.name: SourceRange
classes.description: Represents a range within source code, with functions for highlighting and printing context.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents source code information, including source ranges and related functions.

classes.name: StackEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in a stack trace, including source range and filename.

methods.name: StringCordView::find
methods.description: Finds a substring within the string view starting from a given position.

methods.name: StringCordView::find_regex
methods.description: Finds a regex pattern within the string view starting from a given position.

methods.name: StringCordView::substr
methods.description: Returns a substring of the string view.

methods.name: SourceRange::highlight
methods.description: Highlights the source range in an output stream.

methods.name: format_stack_trace
methods.description: Formats and outputs a stack trace with source code context.

methods.name: SourceRange::print_with_context
methods.description: Prints the source range with surrounding context and optional highlighting.
